description: This Java class defines the SystemNotification entity, which models system notifications associated with merchants and users. It includes fields for notification key-value pairs, relevant dates, and audit information, and is mapped to the database table 'SYSTEM_NOTIFICATION'.

classes.name: SystemNotification
classes.description: Entity representing a system notification with key-value data, optional associations to merchant store and user, and validity dates.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Retrieves the audit section information for the entity.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit section information for the entity.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the notification.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the notification.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Retrieves the start date of the notification validity period.

methods.name: setStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the notification validity period.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Retrieves the end date of the notification validity period.

methods.name: setEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the notification validity period.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves the associated user for the notification.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Associates a user with the notification.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Retrieves the merchant store associated with the notification.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates a merchant store with the notification.
